notes:
Summary: Synapse is a fast-growing developer platform (internal dev tools + customer-facing SDKs). Primary pain: devs waste time finding canonical code snippets and triaging PRs; they want a production RAG that prioritizes accurate code-level matches and returns snippets with context.

Key constraints / requirements (engineering):
- Corpus scale: ~200M small code blobs (functions, snippets) + 15M markdown docs; expect steady ingestion 50k new artifacts/day plus frequent updates from CI (re-index frequently).
- Indexing: incremental + atomic rollouts required. Full re-index nightly is not acceptable for some repos; need near-real-time updates for hot paths.
- Embedding scale: estimate 200M embeddings (512–1k dims), store tiering desired (hot vs cold).
- Retrieval latency target: end-to-end (ANN retrieval + transformer reranker) p95 < 250ms for most queries; goal p50 ~80ms.
- Throughput: baseline QPS 200, peak 1k (sustained bursts for internal load tests).
- Cost target: target blended cost per query (retrieval + rerank) <$0.005; high sensitivity to per-token rerank cost.
- Models: prefer open/quantized embedding models for retrieval; reranker may be a compact fine-tuned encoder-decoder hosted on GPU. Needs GPU and CPU fallback.
- Feature needs: prefix/KV caching for session queries, adaptive batching, auto-routing to cheaper model variants under load.

Security / compliance notes:
- Must integrate with enterprise SSO (SAML). IdP: Okta + Microsoft Entra for some teams.
- Data residency: some customer code must remain in US-only regions.
- Audit: request detailed audit logs for access + query samples retention controls for compliance.
- KMS integration required for any Private deployment.
